page.overview:
Who is Quetzel Carthach?

Quetzel Carthach, also known as the "Angelbane," was a notorious Chaos Lord of the Alpha Legion active in the Maelstrom Zone of the Ultima Segmentum. His army, the so-called "Sons of the Hydra," was a great coalition of Heretic Astartes warbands and allied Chaos Cultists united by their common hatred of the Imperium of Man.

Commanding the Sons of the Hydra, Quetzel gained quasi-authority over other independent Alpha Legion cells such as The Redacted as he waged a campaign in the Maelstrom Zone to destroy as many of the Successor Chapters of the Ultramarines as he could in vengeance for Roboute Guilliman's supposed slaying of Omegon at Eskrador during the Great Scouring.

At one point, Carthach fell under the influence of an allegedly returned Alpharius; furthermore, a Necron Cryptek named Omizhar Vohk was able to become his advisor. Both tried to manipulate Carthach to their own ends, and Carthach's activities ultimately led the Sons of the Hydra to assault the homeworlds of the Vindicators, Crimson Consuls, Nova Legion, and finally the Marines Mordant, which resulted in the destruction of all four Chapters. As such, he was the target of many assassination attempts arranged by the Inquisition.

Very little is known about Carthach, and as always when dealing with the illusive Alpha Legion, what information can be gathered may well be fabrications and lies. Quetzel Carthach is believed to have been killed on the world of Vitrea Mundi, slain with the vast majority of his troops after he captured the fortress-monastery of Ba-Silica, the seat of power of the Marines Mordant Chapter. In truth, he was later slain aboard his own warship Iota-Æternus when the vessel's Daemonic spirit turned against its own crew.
